meta.title: Tivren Budget · Household budget app, coming to iPhone and Android

hero.pill: Coming soon to iPhone and Android
hero.title: Your household budget,
hero.lead: Plan each month in a few steps, give every euro a job, and watch your savings grow. Tivren Budget shows what's left to spend, warns you before a category runs over, and keeps the whole picture in one place.
hero.appAlt: Tivren Budget's home screen: the remaining budget for November, the income card, top categories with their caps and recent spendings

features.title: Everything a monthly budget needs
features.lead: Built for households that want to know where the money goes, without spreadsheets.

items.title: Plan the month in minutes
items.text: Add what's coming in, set aside savings, then spread the rest across categories. A short guided plan, once a month.

items.title: Caps for every category
items.text: Give each category a monthly cap until all your income has a job. Logging a spending takes a few taps.

items.title: Savings vaults
items.text: Keep an emergency fund, a trip or a new car in its own vault, with a target and a bar that fills up as you save.

items.title: Insights that make sense
items.text: See your daily pace against a safe pace, which days you spend the most, and how this month compares to the last.

items.title: Gentle reminders
items.text: A heads-up when a category is close to its cap or goes over, and a nudge to plan the next month.

items.title: Private and locked
items.text: Start as a guest with everything on your phone, or sign in to keep it in sync. Lock the app with Face ID or your fingerprint.

how.title: How a month works
how.lead: Three steps, the same every month.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: Enter your take-home income, choose how much goes to your vaults, and set a cap for each category.

steps.title: Spend
steps.text: Log spendings as they happen. Tivren Budget keeps the amount left to spend up to date, and tells you if you're running hot.

steps.title: Look back
steps.text: At month's end, see where it went, what you saved, and plan the next one with what you learned.

pro.title: Tivren Pro, on the way
pro.lead: Tivren Budget is free to start. Later, Pro adds more for the whole household.

items.title: Unlimited vaults and categories
items.text: As many as your household needs.

items.title: Bank sync
items.text: Transactions that import and sort themselves.

items.title: Child accounts
items.text: Managed profiles and allowance tracking for kids.

items.title: Deeper insights
items.text: Trends by week, quarter and year, with forecasts.

items.q: When will Tivren Budget be available?
items.a: Soon. Tivren Budget is in its final round of testing. It will come out on the App Store and Google Play, and this page will have the links on launch day.
Yes, Tivren Budget is free to start, with everything you need for a monthly budget. Tivren Pro, with more for households, comes later and is optional.
No. You can use Tivren Budget as a guest and keep everything on your phone. If you sign in later with Google, Apple or email, Tivren Budget offers to move your data to your account.

items.q: Does Tivren Budget connect to my bank?
items.a: Not at launch. You enter your income and spendings yourself, so Tivren Budget never sees your bank login. Bank sync is planned for Tivren Pro.
English and Romanian, with the currency of your choice.
